brief: Slovak bank-earnings news is a layered, mostly Slovak-language market: the numbers originate with NBS statistics and issuer press releases (slsp.sk, tatrabanka.sk PDFs), are distributed within hours by the two wires (TASR, free via teraz.sk; SITA via its /vofinanciach/ vertical), and are then interpreted by a specialist tier (Finsider.sk, Forbes.sk, Denník E) and rewritten by a popular tier (oPeniazoch, Interez, Startitup). Finsider and SITA are the highest-value routine collection targets because they are free, per-bank, results-day-dated, and cover banks that issue no English release; FinStat provides the structured statutory cross-check. The two flagship business outlets named in the cell brief — Trend and Hospodárske noviny — could not be verified in this run (a refused fetch and a zero-result search respectively) and must be re-attempted with a browser-grade fetch rather than written off. The payments/technology channel is the weakest part of the cell: no Živé.sk URL was confirmed, so payment-rail news remains under-sourced and needs a dedicated follow-up pass.
